subject: Request: permission to publish AnthemAI case spotlight & logo
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@anthemai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permission to publish AnthemAI case spotlight & logo

Hi Emily —

Hope you’re well. We’ve pulled together a short draft customer spotlight based on our work on latency improvements and throughput tuning for AnthemAI’s recommendation pipeline. Before we publish on the Redwood blog and add a one-page customer spotlight to our marketing site, could you confirm the following:

- Permission to use AnthemAI name and primary logo (PNG/SVG) on the website and blog post.
- Approval for the attached pull-quote (short wording attributed to Emily Zhang / Head of ML Ops).
- Any brand guidelines we should follow (logo spacing, colors, co-branding rules).

I’ve attached the draft case spotlight and a sample quote card for review. If you need changes we can move quickly — ideally we’d publish the week of Sept 6.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Redwood-case-draft-AnthemAI-v1.pdf, Quote-card-AZ-90.png

Cc: AnthemAI Legal <legal@anthemai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: permission to publish AnthemAI case spotlight & logo

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the draft and for the heads up. Quick notes from AnthemAI side:

- We’re generally happy to be featured. Please use our primary horizontal logo (I’ll loop legal on the asset request).
- The pull-quote looks fine but would you please change “100x lower latency” to “under 100x reduction in median latency” — legal prefers less absolute language.
- We have a brand pack and a brief trademark usage doc; I’ve cc’d legal to confirm any required verbiage.

I’ll get the brand kit over by EOD tomorrow. Sept 6 is OK as a target.

—Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of ML Ops, AnthemAI

Hi Camila / team —

Legal has reviewed the materials. High level: we’re comfortable granting permission for a customer spotlight provided the following are included and agreed in writing:

1) Final quote text is mutually agreed and limited to the attached pull-quote. No additional attribution beyond job title is included without separate approval.
2) Logo use: AnthemAI horizontal logo only; colors must not be altered; clearspace per brand guide (attached in a follow-up).
3) Publication rights: Redwood may use the final case spotlight, headline, and approved logo across marketing channels (web, blog, sales collateral) in perpetuity.
4) Right to review: AnthemAI requests a final review and one round of edits before publication.

If that’s acceptable we can provide a short permission email (signed by AnthemAI Legal) once the final version is provided. Please include Redwood’s standard publication language in the final doc (we can draft).

Best,
AnthemAI Legal Team
legal@anthemai.com

Thanks for the heads up — tagging in legal on our side for the sign-off path. A couple of asks from Redwood legal / comms before we send the final:

- Please incorporate Emily’s wording change to the latency stat ("under 100x reduction in median latency").
- We'll include a short publication clause (one-paragraph license) allowing Redwood web/blog/social use; AnthemAI will retain trademark ownership.
- Comms: include a 48-hour review window for AnthemAI on final layout and a credit line: "Case study conducted in collaboration with AnthemAI."

Camila — can you upload the updated PDF and the high-res logo Emily sends to the Drive folder and reply-all with the final files? I’ll prepare our publication clause and share it as a short email for AnthemAI to sign.

—Rafael

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. I’ve updated the draft to reflect the adjusted latency wording and swapped in the horizontal logo you provided. Both files are in the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cdAnthemSpotlight (attached below).

Attachments uploaded: Redwood-case-draft-AnthemAI-v1.pdf (updated), Quote-card-AZ-90.png (final).

AnthemAI retains all trademark rights. AnthemAI will have one (1) review cycle of final layout prior to publication."

Please let me know if any further tweaks are needed.
